question.text: Capital gain LTCG on transfer of Cat III AIF UNITS (if classified as 'equity-oriented investment fund') is taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Long-term capital gains on transfer of units of an equity-oriented Category III AIF are taxed at 12.5%, consistent with the Fund TM example which taxes the full LTCG at 12.5%. The Trap: 10%, 20% and 30% are not the prescribed LTCG rate for transfer of equity-oriented Cat III AIF units in this context. Note: The Rs. 1.25 lakh exemption discussed under Section 112A applies to listed equity, equity-oriented schemes and business-trust assets and is not applied to the Cat III AIF unit-transfer example in the source.
